speech.heard: For every 100 working-age people, Japan has 51 older dependents, Qatar has two. That counts people older than 64 against those aged 15 to 64, the USA has 29. Asia's largest populations divide sharply, China has 21 while India has 11. Europe crowds the top of the globe, Portugal has 40, Italy has 40, Finland has 39, and Greece has 39. Much of Africa stays young. Nigeria has five older dependents per 100 of working age. Where does your country land?
